changelog:
**New version adds comprehensive playbooks, FOFA permission awareness, recurring monitoring, and local learning capability.**

- Added multiple playbooks, syntax guides, report templates, and a reusable query syntax corpus for more robust and flexible FOFA workflows.
- Enhanced skill to detect FOFA membership tier and capability profile, improving automatic field selection and error handling.
- Introduced recurring asset monitoring and inventory drift detection using monitor mode and snapshot comparison.
- Added local bounded memory to support self-improvement across runs, including learning from failures, friction, and reporting patterns.
- Expanded quick start examples to cover advanced and recurring use cases.
- Updated workflow and reference sections to reflect new monitoring, red team, and reporting guidance.
summary: Use this skill when the user wants FOFA-based asset discovery, host profiling, distribution statistics, icon_hash generation, query refinement after zero-res...
